design_philosophy.identity: The Performance Pro x Electric Neon
design_philosophy.vibe: Institutional Grade, Deep Space, Premium Trading Terminal, Tactical
core_principles: Data Density with Breathing Room: High information density paired with generous padding (p-6/p-8) to exude a premium feel.
Zero Distraction: Deep Charcoal/Space Blue dark mode only.
Color is Signal: Emerald Green for Money/Long. Electric Rose for Danger/Short. Cyber Blue for Info.
Glassmorphism & Glows: Translucent sidebar, neon glows on active signal cards.

layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode B: High Density modified for Premium Spacing)

containers.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 md:p-8 min-h-screen
containers.sidebar: w-72 border-r border-white/5 bg-crypto-bg/60 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 flex flex-col fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-40
containers.main_content: pl-0 md:pl-72 flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-screen relative

PremiumCard.base: bg-crypto-card/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-crypto-border rounded-lg relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-white/10 transition-colors p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col shadow-xl
PremiumCard.header: flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-white/5 mb-4

WhaleFlow2.heat_bar: w-full h-3 rounded-full bg-crypto-bg border border-crypto-border overflow-hidden flex

Button.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-md font-semibold px-6 py-3 transition-all active:scale-95 text-sm uppercase tracking-wide
Button.ghost: text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.grid_lines: background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #1C232D 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, #1C232D 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 64px 64px; mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black, transparent 80%);

motion.number_ticker: Use framer-motion to animate number changes

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients uses text-shadow to maintain 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='whale-flow-bar', data-testid='radar-mentor-card'.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for premium, clean aesthetic.

3d_libraries.charts: lightweight-charts for high-performance trading charts, recharts for simple bar/pie data.
3d_libraries.animations: framer-motion for card entry and layout shifts.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion lightweight-charts clsx tailwind-merge`

TAILWIND CONFIG: Add the custom colors (bullish: '#00FF9D', bearish: '#FF1E56', cyber: '#00F0FF', crypto-bg: '#06080A', crypto-card: '#0C1015', crypto-border: '#1C232D') and fonts (Rajdhani, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) to tailwind.config.js.
LAYOUT: Build the Sidebar using glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-crypto-bg/60) and keep it fixed on the left.
CARDS: Ensure Premium UI with larger padding (p-6 or p-8). Apply Neon glows (shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(...)]) dynamically based on active states (bullish/bearish).
WHALE FLOW 2.0: Build a visual heat bar component showing split across 5 exchanges (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Bitfinex, Bybit) and a bold 'Institutional Momentum' score (0-100) using JetBrains Mono.
RADAR MENTOR & LIQUIDITY MAGNET: Give these cards max priority in the grid (col-span-8 and col-span-4 respectively). They are focal points.
COMPONENTS: Update existing cards in /components/cards/ to match this premium styling. Note you are working with .js files, NOT .tsx.
ICONS: Migrate icons to Phosphor Icons for a sharper, high-end technical look.
MOCK DATA: Mock any missing data flow, clearly labeling with 'mocked' logic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds. This is a strict Dark Theme application.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sidebar without backdrop-blur-xl and a semi-transparent dark tint.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Always use JetBrains Mono for numbers, prices, scores, and tickers.
Never use generic centered layouts. Left-align text for readability, particularly for dense trading data.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='v3-signal-card').
